body: Audit B-56 (6 Nov 2026): the gateway judges 'public' from the connection's address. On Docker Desktop (and rootless Docker, Podman) a visitor is counted against the Docker gateway, 172.19.0.1 (proven on this PC from the server's log), so a port forward opens the music server's /app, /api and /auth to the internet. P3-34 is now a need of this item. The scripted attacker run should include `audit_stack.py check homedoor`. docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-56.
